summary: ReNew Energy Global plc filed a Form 6-K announcing its fifth Annual General Meeting (AGM) to be held on September 16, 2026, in London. The filing is a routine meeting notice with standard resolutions covering receipt of annual accounts, approval of directors' remuneration, re-appointment of auditors (KNAV Limited), and authorization for the Board to determine auditor remuneration. The record date is August 18, 2026. No special situation, transaction, or corporate event is involved; this is an ordinary administrative notification to shareholders.
